description_en: Synchronizes local cluster users to a hybrid cloud cluster in hybrid-cloud proxy mode
description_zh: 调用SyncUsers在混合云代理模式下，同步本地集群用户到线上混合云集群中
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc sync-users --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id ehpc-hz-gh5WKb0000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SyncUsers
